node.title: Re^3: Translation Substring Error
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I do like the regex solution though, it's quite elegant.

You can combine my second and third suggestions (for nonexistent codes, this uses the defined-or solution I showed [id://1203059|here], the [doc://exists] solution would work as well):

(my $amino_acid = $seq) =~ s{(...)} { $genetic_code{$1} // 'X' }esg; return $amino_acid;
